author: Central Wisconsin News
title: Rep. John Spiros honors military service and veterans across three November social media posts
text:
John Spiros, Wisconsin State Representative for 86th District | Facebook
John Spiros, Wisconsin State Representative for 86th District | Facebook
Rep. John Spiros, a Republican serving Wisconsin’s 86th House district since 2013, marked a series of tributes to military service and veterans in a sequence of social media posts published between November 10 and November 12, 2025.
On November 10, Spiros commemorated the anniversary of the United States Marine Corps by stating, "Happy 250th Birthday to the @USMC. Thank you to all Marines, past and present, for your service, sacrifice, and unwavering dedication to our nation. Semper Fi!"
The following day, Veterans Day, Spiros extended his appreciation to all U.S. Armed Forces members with a message that highlighted his own background as a veteran: "On this Veterans Day, I want to extend my gratitude to all who have taken the oath and served our nation in the U.S. Armed Forces. As a veteran myself, I truly appreciate the sacrifices our service members have made to protect our peace and freedom. #VeteransDay #HomeOfTheBrave"
On November 12, Spiros recognized an individual for her contributions at the local level: "I had the honor of presenting Susan Sternberg with a legislative citation recognizing her as the 2025 Veteran of the Year in Marshfield. After completing her service in the U.S. Army Reserves, Susan has continued to serve our veteran community through her work as a member of"
Spiros has represented Wisconsin's 86th House district since succeeding Jerry Petrowski in 2013.
